content:
Zed Editor is good for PHP, but one of the biggest criticism of has been its setup. PHPantom requires you to manually download it to your computer, plus use Zed Editor to compile and install the extension. Just then you can start coding.
Well, not anymore. You only a couple of clicks now.
The dark times
To give some perspective, using PHP in Zed Editor wasn’t a good pairing until early 2026, mainly because of the lack of a good LSP Server — the software that makes the editor understand the code.
Zed Editor, for many months, has shipped their official PHP extension with very basic functionality. For larger projects, you still required a separate LSP Server, which before 2026 was either a resource-hogging, a paid solutions, or both. Early this year, PHPantom became mature enough to rival and win above all these alternatives.
PHPantom wasn’t available as an LSP Server in the extension registry of Zed Editor, which made things worse. You were not only forced to download the repository in your computer, but also have rustc installed and available, plus wait until Zed compiled the extension.
